accepted_theorem: Trivial spin, fixed skew torus, smooth positive b-periodic f(y), max f <= integral_0^b f: full first positive Dirac eigenvalue = 2*pi/integral_0^b f.
required_limits: Cover map-energy bound does not bound the first positive eigenvalue of the pullback metric.
No claim that direct metric-cover counterexample route is closed.
Search failure at b=2 does not prove concentration necessary or absence of a smooth minimizer.
Floating-point search supplies no certified spectral lower bound.
